source: local game 1.5.3 GameAssembly.dll native disassembly (BlackHoleMutator.Mutate) read-only
observations: The Heat Wave aura object is prepared once per Mutate call: Ailment::getAilment(Ignite) -> RepeatedlyApplyAilmentsInRadius::addChance(ailment, chance, ...) at 0x1830333, immediately followed by chill/blind addChance calls on the same aura component. This code is not inside any loop over damage components/stars.
Chance per roll = actor uncapped fire resistance * blackHoleMutator.chanceToIgnitePerUncappedFireRes (0x140) * 0.5; the 0.5 factor is the aura applicationInterval.
The same aura component then gets applicationInterval=0.5f at [aura+0x98] (field 152) and applyOnStart=true at [aura+0xb4] (field 180) at 0x18303eb-0x18303fe.
conclusion: Heat Wave is a single aura per Black Hole cast (one RepeatedlyApplyAilmentsInRadius instance). Binary System two stars share this one aura: there is no second aura/addChance call per star, so expected rolls per second are unchanged by Binary. Roll cadence = spawn + k*0.5 while active, applyOnStart=true; expected stacks/s = 2%/pt * points * uncapped fire res%.
v2_impact: confirms the v2 heat_wave assumption "one roll per Black Hole (not per star)"; no extra numeric change beyond the 0.5s roll interval already implemented.
